question: Which of the following natural resources is an inexhaustible resource?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sunlight**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sunlight** is considered an inexhaustible resource because it is abundant and continuously available.
 
• In contrast, resources like **Petroleum** and **Natural Gas** are exhaustible as they are finite and can be depleted.
 
• **Forests**, although renewable, can be exhausted if not managed sustainably.
 
• Inexhaustible resources are crucial for sustainable development and long-term energy solutions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Solar energy** harnessed from sunlight is one of the cleanest and most sustainable forms of energy.
 
• It plays a significant role in reducing the dependency on fossil fuels and mitigating climate change.
 
• Technological advancements have made solar power more accessible and cost-effective.
 
• Investments in solar energy infrastructure continue to grow globally as part of green energy initiatives.
